summary: Bound caller usage queries with explicit concurrent partition indexes

delivery.outcome: Repair issue142 with caller-leading usage indexes, explicit bounded concurrent maintenance for existing PostgreSQL partitions, safe empty-new-partition indexes, protected source delivery and observed bounded additive migration/runtime readback on the existing local development archive.
nonGoals: No provider/model policy, credentials, dependency or package-release changes. No destructive DDL, data deletion, arbitrary SQL, historical backfill on provider writes or query deadline increase. Preserve full-message search and exact aggregates.

architecture.decision: Caller/kind/started-at/id expression indexes belong to the existing archive. First-use writes index only a newly created empty leaf. An explicit native module CLI observes existing leaves, pins a metadata-only plan and builds at most four indexes concurrently with lock/statement bounds. Existing conflicting/invalid indexes are preserved and reported. Plan/readback grant no publication authority.
interfaceChanges: Explicit bounded usage-index maintenance module CLI

dataChanges.description: Additive nonunique archive indexes; payloads and ownership remain unchanged. Existing local archive is migrated explicitly only after protected source publication and exact metadata-plan observation.

architecture.rollback: Protected source revert preserves existing query behavior and all data. Added nonunique indexes need no removal to roll back; any removal requires separate exact authority.

commands: python -m ruff check --no-respect-gitignore src tests integration
validation.evidence: Real partitioned PostgreSQL large-message fixture, exact query/search/pagination parity, plan-index evidence, stale/conflicting-plan failures, bounded apply/no hot-path history and full protected checks; deployment/readback distinct from source publication.
